name: bureau_score_drop_50
label: Bureau score dropped 50+ points
description: Y if the account's bureau score fell by 50 points or more since its previous billing cycle, N if not, n/a for its first cycle in the data.
expr: CASE WHEN LAG(BUREAU_SCORE) OVER (PARTITION BY ACCOUNT_KEY ORDER BY BILLING_CYCLE_DATE) IS NULL THEN 'n/a' WHEN LAG(BUREAU_SCORE) OVER (PARTITION BY ACCOUNT_KEY ORDER BY BILLING_CYCLE_DATE) - BUREAU_SCORE >= 50 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
choices: A drop of exactly 50 points counts
Compared with the previous cycle only, not a longer window
